test_rate_limit_wrapper_disabled: test the RateLimitWrapper with zero or negative rate to verify no sleep is called
test_rate_limit_wrapper_enabled: test the RateLimitWrapper with a positive rate to verify sleep is called between steps
test_rate_limit_wrapper_sleep_before: test the RateLimitWrapper with sleep type BEFORE to verify sleep occurs before step
test_rate_limit_wrapper_sleep_after: test the RateLimitWrapper with sleep type AFTER to verify sleep occurs after step
test_rate_limit_wrapper_after_with_repea: test the RateLimitWrapper with AFTER_WITH_REPEAT to verify double step with accumulated rewards
